title: Fix endpoint playground code examples and settings link to use project secret API keys
answers: Why do code examples copied from the endpoint playground fail authentication?
Why does the endpoint playground API key button link to personal API keys instead of project secret keys?
How to fix authorization headers in EndpointPlayground snippet generators?
body:
Symptom: Endpoint playground code examples fail to authenticate when copied, and the API keys button opens settings for personal API keys which endpoints do not accept.
Root cause: products/endpoints/frontend/endpoint-tabs/EndpointPlayground.tsx:EndpointPlayground linked to personal API keys and generated Python/Node code with literal placeholder tokens.
Fix pattern: Link to products/endpoints/frontend/endpoint-tabs/EndpointPlayground.tsx:PROJECT_SECRET_API_KEY_SETTINGS_SECTION and use language-standard environment variable lookups for POSTHOG_PROJECT_SECRET_API_KEY.
Constraints: Applies to endpoint playground snippets requiring project secret keys with endpoint:read access; does not apply to features requiring personal API keys.
says: API key button in the playground links to personal keys instead of project secrets
Sample requests copied from the endpoint playground fail due to rejected authentication
Playground should direct users to secret keys needed for querying endpoints
Copied endpoint code returns unauthorized because it references the wrong key type
